analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($64.54) vs SMA5/20/50 ($65.50/$67.06/$65.98) — Below short-term and mid-term moving averages.
· SMA100/200 ($62.62/$60.10) comparison — Above long-term moving averages.
· 52-week position (74.0%) + Current price level is in a pullback from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.7 → 39.6) + Entering oversold + Downward momentum confirmed.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -0.3334 → -0.3334) + Weak convergence maintained + No trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $64.84) + Bandwidth narrowed to 6.63%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($63.90) + Based on Pivot S1 ($63.06).
· Swing resistance ($68.35) + Significance if 5-day high ($66.85) is broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + Potential for recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.39x vs 5-day average) + Low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Confirmation of conditions for waiting.
